votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items B-1 through B-5 to a future consent agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on five grant applications (FY25 OJP CVIPI Grant, Law Enforcement-Based Victim Services Mini-Grant, 2025 DUI Enforcement Equipment Grant, Surface Transportation Program 2025, and Congestion Mitigation Air Quality/Carbon Reduction Program 2025) and refers them to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Consolidated Fee Schedule Corrections – Public Utilities ordinance to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed ordinance amending the Salt Lake City Consolidated Fee Schedule to correct errors and omissions related to Public Utilities fire line rate tables, and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Ratify the nominations of Council Member Puy as Chair and Council Member Carlsen as Vice Chair for calendar year 2026.
votes.description: Formally ratifies the election of Alejandro Puy as Council Chair and Erika Carlsen as Vice Chair of the Salt Lake City Council for calendar year 2026.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 1 of 2026, amending the Salt Lake City Consolidated Fee Schedule related to credit card surcharges in the Public Lands Department.
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance correcting errors and omissions in the Consolidated Fee Schedule by adding an exemption to credit card use surcharge fees for certain transactions in the Public Lands Department.

Approves all consent agenda items including an ordinance clarification for RMF 35/45 amendments, setting public hearing dates for the Silo Park Public Infrastructure District and Budget Amendment No. 4, and board reappointments for Andy Robertson (Business Advisory Board), Julia Summerfield, Katherine Durant, and Steven Calbert (Racial Equity in Policing Commission), and Shireen Mooers (Mosquito Abatement District).
